reviews.author: J K
reviews.text: Especially to all the bingsu lovers out there. They've got several choices of flavour which none are too sweet so it's also a perfect place for the older audience as well. Service wise, super friendly staff especially the young couple which are actually the owners of the place! Very attentive and are also super helpful to give suggestions if you're not sure what to try. Bingsu wise: Hoji Cha 10/10 - As a hojicha lover this hit the spot perfectly, with the alternative oatmilk option it was super rich in flavour but also balanced.

reviews.author: Kathryn
reviews.text: Love their hojicha bingsu!!! By far the richest taste I've tried! And every time I come here this is a confirmed repeat order. (This is my 4th time here already) I also like their oolong peach (imagine a chagee but shaved ice version), soybean (you will love it if you like injeolmi), and matcha. Each bingsu comes with 3-4 toppings. You can also modify your toppings. Environment is chill and cozy, also provide drinking water. Overall a perfect hangout place.

reviews.author: Lizzie
reviews.text: Tried Binq for the first time and had a pleasant experience. Flavors were different than other bingsu places, worth trying because so far no other places has these flavours, it's always the same old thing (always green tea, oreo or yogurt) so this is something refreshing. Appreciate the fact that we can change toppings if we like. Space was quite clean. I noticed the guy owner cleaning up constantly, looking around and keeping the place tidy.
